eir.0060 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0060.t
	desc = eir.0060.desc
	theme = legend
	cooldown = { years = 200 }

	trigger = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		current_year >= 1086
		has_title = title:d_munster
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_hist_1086 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0060.a
		stress_impact = {
			humble = minor_stress_impact_gain
			ambitious = miniscule_stress_impact_loss
		}
		add_prestige = 250
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_gaelic_revival_modifier years = 10 }
		set_global_variable = eir_done_oenach
		set_global_variable = eir_hist_1086
		eir_vassal_opinion_effect = { MODIFIER = eir_ard_ri_opinion OPINION = 8 }
		ai_chance = { base = 50 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0060.b
		stress_impact = {
			ambitious = minor_stress_impact_gain
			content = miniscule_stress_impact_loss
		}
		add_prestige = 50
		set_global_variable = eir_hist_1086
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0060.c
		trigger = {
			exists = title:d_meath.holder
		}
		add_prestige = 100
		add_hook = { target = title:d_meath.holder type = favor_hook }
		set_global_variable = eir_hist_1086
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}
}
